description: Send Check: one call before an agent sends USDC or ETH on Base. Recipient on the OFAC sanctions list -> STOP; recipient is the token contract itself -> STOP; ADDRESS POISONING (recipient looks like a payee you used before, same first and last 4 characters, but isn't) -> STOP; sender balance too low -> STOP; recipient is a contract or a never-used address -> CAUTION. Verdict SEND / CAUTION / STOP with reasons. Read-only public chain data; never signs or moves money. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/send/check, $0.005 via x402.)
